stitch.description: Google Stitch — generates Figma-faithful UI variants from prompts + Figma context.

figma.description: Figma Developer MCP — extracts variables, auto-layout, Code Connect metadata.

vercel.description: Vercel MCP — deploy, env management, and log streaming.

github.description: GitHub MCP — PR diff inspection, commit history.

_meta.setup: 1. Copy this file to .mcp.json  2. Set env vars: STITCH_API_KEY (Google AI Studio), FIGMA_API_KEY (Figma → Settings → Personal access tokens), VERCEL_TOKEN (vercel.com/account/tokens)  3. No secrets should ever be hardcoded in this file.
